name: Discipline Team
subtitle: Tasks and routines
description: Discipline for AltStore Classic. Tasks, routines, daily streaks, AI photo verification, and opt-in nearby device pairing for iOS Guided Access single-app mode.

apps.name: Discipline
apps.subtitle: Tasks, routines, and focus
apps.localizedDescription: Manage tasks and recurring routines that reset reliably by calendar day, build a daily streak without freezes, opt into iOS Guided Access to lock the app while a task is active, verify tasks with AI photos, and customize the language, color scheme, and app icon. Guided Access must be enabled in iOS Settings first. Available in English and German.

versions.localizedDescription: Pair nearby devices locally: device 1 can activate or end Guided Access strict mode on device 2. Device 2 requires Guided Access enabled in iOS Settings and can unlock with the Discipline PIN after the connection is lost. Both devices must have the app open and accept pairing.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Die Kamera nimmt das Abschlussfoto für die KI-Prüfung der Aufgabe auf.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Discipline verbindet Gerät 1 und Gerät 2 über das lokale Netzwerk, um den Strict Mode auf Gerät 2 zu steuern.

news.title: Discipline 1.0.9: Nearby Device Pairing
news.caption: Pair nearby devices and let the host control Guided Access strict mode on device 2.
